verdict.rationale: iTerm2's GitHub README describes a built-in LLM chat window. It can link to sessions for context-aware help, run commands on the user's behalf, and annotate output, which is genuine task delegation inside the product. It also works in browser sessions. Generative AI features require an optional AI plugin component, and community discussion confirms the feature is opt-in and needs an OpenAI key. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on agentic delegation scope and approval flow, no out-of-the-box use without installing the plugin and supplying an API key, no hands-on corroboration of the run-commands-on-your-behalf capability.
